description: Definition of a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for UserAccount entities, providing methods to find a user by email and check email existence.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository interface extending MongoRepository for UserAccount entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a UserAccount by email, returning an Optional.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks if a UserAccount exists with the given email.
